result.title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. Comparisons of RL with best-of-N should therefore check the selected images by hand.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 398 个 GenEval 风格新 prompt 上，用人工标注与两个不同于奖励的自动评判器，比较 SD3.5 Medium 及其实验室 Flow-GRPO checkpoint 与 best-of-N 采样的「汇率」，即一张 RL 生成图相当于多少张基础模型采样图；结果显示该比值强烈依赖 prompt（是否含位置关系），且检测式与 VLM 式自动评判器偏差方向相反。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽是文生图研究，但其「推理期多采样+选择器」与「训练后收益」的可比量化框架及「自动评判器不可靠、需人工核验」的警示，可能可供核查 LVR 中 test-time 采样、验证器质量与训练投入之间的收益权衡，以及停止决策评价的偏差来源。
